ics_names_sources.note: Scala Cronostratigrafica Internazionale v2022/02, traduzione a cura della Commissione Italiana di Stratigrafia. Names copied as printed; series of Triassico, Giurassico and Cretacico are printed as Inferiore/Medio/Superiore inside the system column and are written here in the chart caption form (e.g. Paleogene superiore). Upper Pennsylvanian is left in English.
